main_question: Does shared colonial-era imperial history help account for introduced-host and newly indexed butterfly assemblage similarity among islands with actual indexed ports, and does previously observed host-butterfly similarity persist under history controls?

geo_matching.primary: 2019 WPI port points inside official WGSRPD3 polygon, or nearest polygon boundary <=10 km, geodesic distance; unique code chosen alphabetically if multiple intersects
geo_matching.source_polygon_repair: shapely.make_valid only, log repaired TDWG region names and polygon area change
geo_matching.island_eligible: at least one matched WPI port and at least half WPI ports on island successfully matched to an official WGSRPD3 region with 80%-105% Lenzner source area overlap
geo_matching.multiple_regions_per_island: average colonial years over successfully matched original WPI ports (unweighted), keep dispersion and region IDs, no single forced colonial label
geo_matching.multi_country_landmass: Borneo (landmass_id 9) keeps island-level port mapping but is excluded from a country-bilateral maritime sensitivity

history.primary_shared_metric: sum across GB,ESP,PRT,NL of min(islandA port-mean years, islandB port-mean years), 0 only when both original matched history vectors are present
history.binary_shared_history: at least one empire where both island port-mean durations>=25 years
no_claims: continuous historical overlap at same years

models.outcome: 2011–2022 first-indexed GBIF butterfly assemblage Jaccard (not colonization), 51-island frozen universe, only matched islands retained
models.base: log1p representative port distance, earlier indexed butterfly Jaccard, earlier butterfly species richness min/max, candidate alien host species richness min/max, indexed WPI port count min/max
models.base_plus_history: base + log1p shared colonial duration + binary shared history
models.base_plus_history_host_interaction: base + history + candidate-host Jaccard + candidate-host Jaccard×log1p shared colonial duration
models.source_lsBCI_models: same matched islands restricted to observed different-country 2010 LSBCI; sequentially add original country-pair index, shared empire duration, and host candidate similarity
models.scoring: leave-one-entire-island-out ridge lambda1, standardize training only, clip Jaccard predictions [0,1], each island equal weighted MSE and MAE
models.secondary_associations: Spearman/partial rank shipping or colonial history × host/butterfly Jaccard controlling log-distance, earlier butterfly Jaccard and source catalogue island richness
models.dependence: 51-island pair observations repeat island nodes; no pair-independent p-values or naive confidence intervals

no_data_peeking_rules: Do not select a closer/further WPI-TDWG cut point by butterfly response or strongest positive correlation
Report all cutoffs (2/10/25 km), matched island counts and selected island IDs
Do not label 2010 UNCTAD country bilateral LSBCI as individual port routes
Keep 2001–2024 pooled plant source as contemporary association, never plant-first temporal causal effect
The full 51-island positive original host-butterfly correlation remains valid descriptive evidence even when historic port-to-region coverage is poor
Do not join this limited 51-island response to separate 169 region GBIF beta as if independent simultaneous observations
